160558.overview: Tom Thumb is a scrolling platform game where you take the role of Tom as he explores the Tomb of Pharaoh Manilo for fabulous wealth. As you explore the Tomb, you will encounter various creatures as well as traps that include spikes and floors that disappear when walked on. If you touch a creature, trap or fall from a certain height then you lose one of five lives. Blocking certain routes are doors that require keys to be found and used on them. Ladders can be used to move up or down to other platforms and floors of the Tomb. As well as the having the ability to jump, you also have the ability to run.

164203.overview: On a distant planet, 36 Time Orbs have been placed in three zones and in 24 hours time the planet will be destroyed unless all the Orbs are destroyed. You have been sent to the planet to save it by controlling three different vehicles and crafts in the three zones and they are the planets surface, underground caverns and underwater. The game is a side view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen is split into three parts showing all three vehicles and crafts and they are a spacefighter for the surface, jet-pack for the underground caverns and a mini-sub for underwater. As the game starts you select which one to control and you move from right to left destroying all aliens, vehicles, weapons and the orbs as the main clock counts to zero.

164211.overview: An imaginative action game in which you must guide a ball-shaped craft through a succession of levels. These have a patchwork-quilt type display, with holes to avoid, and squares of various colors, which affect the craft's speed, both within its power potential and into warp, as well as a control-reverser and lots of holes. You can jump and thus avoid these holes, although you have a limited number of them for each level, and it's possible to adjust the speed through joystick or keyboard control. You also face a time limit on each of the levels, although your time is boosted every time you complete one.

164214.overview: Tutti Frutti is based on the arcade game Mr. Do! where you play Super Strawberry, The King of the Orchard who must collect all the ripe cherries. Trying to stop you are the Acid Apple Gang who wander around the orchard and one touch from them loses one of five lives but you can fire at them to kill them. Walking through the dirt creates a path which the Gang can walk on but they can't walk through the dirt themselves. Be careful walking under apples as well as you have a very short time before it falls on top of you. Collect all the cherries on the level and you move to the next one. The whole level is shown on one screen and as well as the main playing area you can also see your score, time, Bonus, lives, level and a high score table.

171929.overview:
Treasure Island is an arcade adventure based on the Robert Louis Stevenson's book. You play the role of Jim Hawkins who has to get to Treasure Island, defeat pirates and defeat Long John Silver.

Jim must get on to a ship and avoid the enemies before being whisked off to Treasure Island. On the island Jim must encounter and avoid various pirates. Scattered on the island are cutlasses which can be used to kill pirates blocking his path. Beware though, cutlasses are limited so Jim doesn't want to waste them on any old pirate. Get hit by a cutlass or touched by a pirate and you lose a live sending you back to the start of the screen.

Search the island, find Long John Silver and become rich beyond your wildest dreams.

The game is viewed from a side, top down view. The game doesn't scroll but flicks to the next screen as you explore this maze. Your score is shown as a percentage of the game completed.

186715.overview:
Description
Mining Engineers working on the planet Krion have inadvertently triggered its destruction, and must escape in this vertically-scrolling shoot 'em up. There are over 100 screens to fly through, and they include many barriers and narrow paths, as well as force fields. There are also time-shift fields - some move you forward, but some send you back to the start.

Enemies are in short supply - the game's feel resembles Artificial Dreams (from the same designer). You have limited fuel and must collect fuel tokens to recharge this. Other available powerups include points bonuses, extra lives, changes to the constant speed of scrolling, and invincibility from force fields (although not enemies).

186716.overview: Thai Boxing is a one-on-one fighting game shown from an isometric perspective (viewed from the side on the Amiga, Atari ST and C16 versions). Different joystick combinations let your fighter perform high, middle or low attacking moves as well as dodge or block his opponent's attacks. Fighters receive scores for successful attacks. The more difficult or effective the attack, the higher the score. Unless one fighter is knocked out, the fighter who has the highest score at the end of three rounds wins. Although the game is shown from an isometric perspective, it is not possible to move in three dimensions.

186717.overview:
In the first half of 21st century technological advances allowed for construction of artificial islands. One of such military installations, ARTROCK 6, had turned rogue after being hit by a violent storm, its computer-controlled defensive systems firing upon anything that comes close. The player, being a top pilot, has been chosen to fly an upgraded F-14+2d Tomcat jet to destroy this electronic madness.

Tomcat is a vertically scrolling top-down shooter set in the near future. You can pick up weapon upgrades (more guns, missiles) from destroyed enemies.

186718.overview: Treasure Hunter is a text adventure where your aim is to explore a land looking for and collecting as much treasure as you can. You must solve various problems as well as encounter various creatures. The screen has text which describes your locations and you use the keyboard to type in commands to interact with your surroundings.

186719.overview: You are destined to spend your days running within drains and pipes in an labyrinth of an unknown empire so you have decided to escape. The labyrinth is made up of various levels, each one viewed from the side with the screen scrolling in multiple directions when you move, and you must collect all the jewels to move to the next level before a strict time limit reaches zero. As you run around the pipes you use up energy shown by a gauge, and if you touch any creature then this decreases it even further. You are armed with a gun to shoot the creatures but the ammo is limited but extra ammo and energy can be found. Gates can block your path but keys are scattered around each level to collect and open the gates, with lifts to help you get to higher parts of the labyrinth. If your energy runs out or the clock reaches zero then you lose one of four lives.

186720.overview: You have come to Twin Kingdom Valley which is one of many valleys that surround Lake Watersmeet to make your fortune by finding treasure and even robbing certain locals who live here as well. Be warned as the people of the land move about in real time going about their business so people won't be in the same place twice. You have rented a hut from the local inn, The Sword Inn so you can store everything that you collect (or Steal). Other items can be found to make your quest easier like swords and armour. There is even talk that the secret of life is hidden here. Twin Kingdom Valley is a graphic text adventure where you will see a picture (with some animation) of your location before seeing a text description of what you can see, any items and any characters in that location. You type in commands to control your player. You can ask to see your score and your strength score. Your strength score is high at the start but not eating or drinking, or being attacked will weaken you and decrease your strength score, but you can wait (if it is safe) to increase it. The aim of the game is to get 1024 points. The mobile phone release is an expanded version of the game with additional locations, puzzles and creatures. It also features predictive text entry.

186721.overview:
Players take on the role of Tycoon Tex, an oil tycoon and with the task is to protect the pipeline by patrolling it and fixing any gaps and shooting bombs that are dropped by jet fighters over various levels.

The game is a side view horizontal scroller and the player must run along the pipeline at a controlled speed by going faster or slower. To complete the level, the player must fill a % complete gauge before the oil pressure gauge reaches zero by jumping over any gaps in the pipeline to fix them. The faster the player runs, the quicker the pressure gauge decreases. Bombs dropped from the jets make gaps, however they can be shot; if the player misses, the gap may be jumped to fix it.

If the player hits a gap or a bomb, the player will lose a life. Before the game starts, the player may select how many lives to have (1-6). There are also three difficulty levels to choose from: easy, hard, and impossible.

205625.overview: You are the commander of a submarine and it's your mission to fire torpedoes and destroy a convoy of ships in this single screen 1st person game. You look through your periscope and when any ship comes into view you fire your torpedoes but once the torpedoes have been fired you can't fire anymore until they hit or miss the ships. As you attempt to destroy ships, an anti-aircraft alert will occasionally start flashing meaning a plane will soon fly across the screen. You must dive under the water and wait until you think it safe to re-surface. If you see the plane then that means the plane has spotted you and it is game over. There are five skill levels (1-5) to choose from with one being the easiest.

214609.overview:
Thrust brings realistic physics and inertia-based movement into arcade games, directly influencing titles like Oids, as well as Exile from Audiogenic by the same author. The action is viewed from the side, with the graphics drawn in vectors, in keeping with the mathematical nature of everything that unfolds.

As a Resistance fighter, the player must fly into enemy lines in order to steal Klystron Pods to power more advanced starships, using your tractor beam to take them. A network of mounted guns are aiming to shoot the player down – these can be disabled by shooting their power source, but eventually this will explode, forcing the player to flee. Some of the later levels feature reverse gravity, which increases the difficulty of the gameplay.

424321.overview:
You are an archaeologist extraordinary, Indiana Bloggs, heroic and resourceful explorer. You have found an ancient manuscript that gives you the whereabouts of the legendary Tomb of Tarrabash that is rumoured to be filled with treasure. Your lust for treasure draws you to go in search of riches, but as soon as you enter the tomb you find if s full of traps and deadly creatures.

This is the setting for this Audio^ genie game, it may not be original but it sets the scene nicely and promises a good game.

You start play in the first level of the tomb. Ifs inhabited with mummies which are produced from a column rather like the transporters in Star Trek. There are also metal bars which flash up and down very quickly, and a kind of portcullis which also moves up and down. To get past these you have to slow them down somehow. I wont tell you how though, you'll have to work that out for yourself. After you get out of that bit its up the stairs to the second part of the first level, which introduces pits of gunge.

446352.overview: Number 10 in the Mysterious Adventures series of interactive fiction is inspired by the Agatha Christie book "And Then There were None". The player's aim is to find the gold statue, formed by Major Johnstone-Smythe from most of his assets shortly before his death. The Major also made 10 worthless copies in various colours, and hid them in and around his mansion. Only the 10 'little indian' figurines, assembled together, would reveal the location of the final golden one. These figurines are hidden behind and under ordinary household objects, and in various hiding places. The game begins in a train carriage and the player's first task is to prevent the train from crashing, which must be achieved in a limited number of moves. Once this has been achieved the train arrives at Lower Massington station and the player must then find their way to the Major's mansion in Upper Massington.

446353.overview: You have been sent to the planet Terra Nova to search for much needed minerals for your home planet. Long range scanners report that the planet is uninhabited but when you approach the planet your short range scanners confirm that there is life and the planet is heavily defended. In this top view vertically scrolling shooter, you must fly over four sectors to get the minerals needed blasting and avoiding aliens and defences. As you fly over the sectors you have limited fuel and ammo which decrease the further you fly but there are various dumps that increase them. To complete a sector you must fly over it three times docking with your Mothership each time which also refuels and rearms your craft. If you touch an alien or defence, or are shot then you lose one of five lives.

446359.overview: Tank Attack is a two player top view single screen shooter, where both players control a tank, moving left or right, at the top and bottom of the screen and try to kill each other. In between the tanks are various obstacles like walls and posts, and the posts can be removed by constantly shooting them. The winner is the player who kills the other player three times.

446360.overview: Your base is due to be attacked by several convoys of ships so you have been tasked to command a submarine and look for the convoys and destroy them. Starting from your base on a single screen map, you must sail around the surrounding waters looking for convoys either on the surface of the water or underneath. You are able to steer your sub as well as control the speed listening to your echo sounder. For a look at your location you can use your periscope to visually check but you can only be so deep under water before you lose the periscope if in use.

446363.overview: Players control Tazzman, a yellow, fun-loving dude who must navigating from room to room shooting bugs with his laser gun. Tazzman can only stand still and shoot in four directions, but cannot shoot while moving. Several hazards prevent Tazz from achieving his goal. Two nasties pursue Tazz, but he is supplied with bombs that he can use to wipe them out, as well as stop the walls from closing in on him. Once Tazz has killed all bugs on the screen, the left and right exits will open up, allowing him to escape into the next room before he is crushed. Every two rooms there is a bonus room which allows Tazz to collect all the numbers, obtain more bombs, and leave through either side.

446374.overview: You play the role of Andros who was banished years ago by King Salimos and can only return when he returns kidnapped Princess Diana and the King's lost treasure taken by an evil Necromancer. You have journeyed to the Necromancer's home, The Tower of Evil to retrieve the stolen treasure and Princess Diana in this top view flick-screen game. Starting on the ground floor, you must search the rooms looking for treasure and a key to use a magic stairway to move up a floor to finally reach the seventh floor where the Princess is. Occupying each floor are various creatures that need to be avoided or shot with fireballs from your fingertips and if you touch a creature then you lose one of five lives but a goblet will give you invincibility for a limited time. Once you reach the seventh floor you must find a chest to place the treasure in before finding and rescuing the Princess who will disappear and you have to start the whole quest again. Two players can play and each player takes it in turns to play when the other player is killed.

446375.overview: Trivia UK is a computer quiz game based on the board game Trivial Pursuit where you have to move around a board from two to four players answering questions on six subjects on various small squares. The categories are Entertainment, History, Sport & Leisure, Geography, Arts & Literature and Science & Nature and each subject is coloured coded. The aim is to collect six pieces before your opponents, one from each subject by answering a question correctly on a large square for each category. The squares go round the edge of the board and you can move either left or right. A dice is thrown to see how many squares you can move and if you answer correctly then you move again, the next player moves if you answer incorrectly. You have to say the answer out loud and tell the computer if the answer was right or wrong.

446382.overview: The Time Machine is the second in the Mysterious Adventure series of text adventures by Brian Howarth. You are a newspaper reporter, come to investigate the eccentric professor who lives all by himself out on the moors. You start the game in a swamp and must find your way to an old manor house. When you get there, you find the place deserted though. Ultimately you must rescue the professor by finding 3 missing prisms which control his time machine, which are lost in time. Items found in one destination sometimes have to be used in another.

446389.overview: Typing Professor is a touch-typing tutor for the C16/Plus4 developed and released by Commodore Educational Software in 1985.

446456.overview: Hippocrates had discovered a cure for cancer in 435 B.C. and recorded the findings on two gold tablets and hid them in a magical forest. Over the years, the tablets have been forgotten until the discovery of the forest and so you have been selected to enter the forest, find the tablets and get back out. Tablets Of Hippocrates is a text adventure where the screen describes each location you visit while you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings. The function keys could be used to input common commands.

446458.overview: The world is on the verge of World War III when M.A.S.T.A., a giant defense computer belonging to NORAD, has developed intelligence and is playing war. You play the role of its creator, Dr. Norton, as you attempt to get into the command centre of NORAD, housed inside Cheyenne Mountain, find a security disk and the access code. Can you save the World from being destroyed? Thermo Nuclear War Games is a graphic text adventure where the screen shows a picture of what you can see, while text describes your location. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

446459.overview: Your planet is under attack by Trizon forces and you are the last of a huge fleet to protect your planet by blasting as many of the invaders in your craft over various levels. The game is a horizontal scrolling shooter viewed from an elevated angle and you must blast as many aliens coming from the right of the screen before an energy gauge runs out. Next to your energy gauge is a Triz Force gauge and to complete a level you must blast the aliens to fill it to the right, if any alien goes past you then the gauge moves to the left. If you touch an alien, it's bullets or allow too many aliens to pass you then you lose one of five lives.

446460.overview: Snide Gaintree and his Mercenaries has taken over a top-secret Air-Force base in the South Pacific containing cruise-missiles, and in less than four hours will be in control of the missiles. You have been sent in a state-of-the-art jetfighter to fly through the various caverns under the base to stop Gaintree in this side view flick screen shooter. As you fly you will encounter various enemy as well as gun-placements and lasers used as gates and if you touch any of these then you lose a life (five on the C64, nine on the C16). Your plane is armed though with various weapons from a standard forward shot to limited 3 direction, vertical shot and a laser. You also have limited shields but more can be collected by shooting barrels. Each level is 20 screens and at the end is an end of level boss that needs destroying to move to the next level.
